children: was in the spotlight on Monday as investment firm Evercore upgraded the networking company to Outperform from In Line, stating it is an “attractive way to gain exposure to the optical networking space.”
“We think CIEN can sustain >30% sales and >35% EPS growth enabling them to achieve if not surpass, $25+ EPS by FY29,” analyst Amit Daryanani wrote in a note to clients.

Delving deeper, Daryanani said he sees the optical networking total addressable market increasing and believes the company could sustain a 24% compound annual growth rate to hit $52B by fiscal 2029. There's also “multiple avenues to grow,” Daryanani added, including its multi-rail optical line system, RLS Hyper-Rail. Other avenues include its DCOM becoming “deeply ingrained” with hyperscalers, increased share for its coherent pluggables, and Nubis getting additional access inside data centers.

Other potential positives include margin expansion, a “call option” for data centers, given that it generates less than $500M in revenue inside the data center, upcoming guidance for fiscal 2027, and an attractive valuation.

“Networking and optical interconnect are becoming larger bottlenecks for the AI buildout and CIEN is positioned to benefit from this,” Daryanani added. “We see CIEN on a path to $25+ EPS by FY29, on low 20x P/E stock should work to $550+.”

title: Ciena in spotlight as Evercore upgrades to Outperform
